name: HyperFrames Block Registry
purpose: Upstream HyperFrames registry of ready-made blocks and components installable through the HyperFrames CLI. Recorded as a candidate source of compositions; nothing has been installed or vendored.
capabilities: Potential source of pre-built scenes, transitions and data visualisations

installation.instructions: Not approved. Before use: review each item's licence and code, pin the CLI version, vendor into the project, and register the item in the catalogue.

licensing.notes: HyperFrames itself is Apache-2.0; individual registry items have not been reviewed. Treat as not cleared for commercial use until checked.

security.notes: Fetches third-party code into the project; requires code review before use.
